text:
alex (PM): Quick sync — dropped a compact composer handoff prototype here: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/compact-composer-handoff (see ‘streaming variants’)

maria (Design): Left a couple inline comments. Main nits: caption contrast on the token badge is low, and the stop/regenerate iconography is ambiguous when compacted.

sam (Eng): Re: token badge — realtime exact token count is expensive to compute for every stream chunk. Can we show an estimated count with a tilde (≈) during streaming and finalise on completion? That saves a lot of CPU and telemetry noise.

jia (DevEx): Agree with the estimate. Accessibility: keyboard flow needs work. Stop should be reachable via Esc (one-tap), regenerate via Ctrl+Enter, and both need focus outlines in high-contrast mode.

maria (Design): From research, users interpret "Stop" as killing the response; "Pause" suggests temporary. What about "Interrupt" for compact UI? it's longer but clearer. Also color suggestion: token badge should be >= 4.5:1 on text/icon. Current #6b6b6b on #ffffff is failing.

alex (PM): "Interrupt" is fine if it reads well on the button. Copy tweak proposal: keep visible label when space allows, otherwise icon with tooltip + aria-label. Thoughts?

sam (Eng): Tooltip+aria-label works. For screen readers we should add an explicit aria-live update when streaming ends: "Generation complete — final token count: N" so SR users don't miss the finalised value.

maria (Design): Yep. Proposed aria labels:

```
<button aria-label="Interrupt generation" title="Interrupt (Esc)">⏹</button>
<button aria-label="Regenerate response" title="Regenerate (Ctrl+Enter)">⟳</button>
```

Also dropped contrast swatches in the fig comment (two options: deep indigo + white, and charcoal + white).

jia (DevEx): VoiceOver note: currently it reads "Stop" but not the context. Use aria-describedby linking to a hidden live region containing "Streaming: 42 tokens (approx.)" during stream.

sam (Eng): Small engineering callout — when we add live regions, keep updates throttled (200–500ms) to avoid SR flooding. Also will implement an approximate client-side token estimator (based on UTF-8 length / average token ratio) and emit final accurate count from server when generation completes.

alex (PM): UX followups: maria, can you update the prototype with the two compact states (label + icon-only)? sam/jia, can you mock the keyboard flows and aria snippets in a slim PR? I'll sync with support to see if we should surface a short tooltip about token estimation.

maria (Design): On it. I'll add the two states and annotate accessibility notes. Will try both "Interrupt" and "Pause" in the tooltip copy to see which reads better in user tests.

preview-bot: Deployed preview for compact-composer branch: https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-composer/1716504321 — please test keyboard nav and contrast.

sam (Eng): Testing now. Found one regression: when regenerating while streaming, the KV cache is cleared but UI can flash. I'll smooth the transition so there isn't a visual jank.

jia (DevEx): Quick checklist I'll add to the PR:
- Esc triggers interrupt (with aria confirmation)
- Ctrl+Enter triggers regenerate
- Focus styles in high-contrast
- Live region updates throttled
- Tooltip copy updated to explain approx tokens

alex (PM): Perfect. Let's aim to land the PR by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
